findings.risk: Setting backup_retention_period to 0 disables automated backups, increasing the risk of permanent data loss and preventing point-in-time recovery after accidental deletion, corruption, or ransomware events.
findings.remediation: Set the attribute backup_retention_period to a value greater than 0, for example backup_retention_period = 7, in the aws_rds_cluster.app1-rds-cluster resource.
